entities.name: Additional configuration indication
entities.description: An information element that the network may include when requesting the UE to register without releasing the N1 NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may include the additional configuration indication IE in certain messages.

entities.name: UE registration without N1 NAS signalling connection release
entities.description: Condition where the UE is requested to register without releasing the N1 NAS signalling connection.

relations.description: The network may include the additional configuration indication IE when requesting UE registration without N1 NAS connection release.
The additional configuration indication IE is included when the condition of UE registration without N1 NAS connection release is met.
